notes.title: Lost in the Void Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

we are happy that you are enjoying the game. We have just managed to push first patch.

+ Fixed some achivements not triggering correctly.
+ Fixed some grammar errors and typos in both languages (ENG & SK).
+ Fixed wrong boundaries on some locations.
+ Fixed some wrong encounters.
+ Other smaller bugs.

We are glad that you are enjoying the game and as always - thanks for your support!

Nightcall Studio
